title: 加拿大卡尼扩大资本配置税收优惠
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I can announce today that we are on track to balance the operating budget next year.
segments.zh: 我今天可以宣布，我们有望在明年实现运营预算平衡。

segments.en: One year ahead of schedule will maintaining the lowest overall deficit in the G7.
segments.zh: 比计划提前一年，同时保持G7中最低的整体赤字。

segments.en: We are making it cheaper to invest.
segments.zh: 我们正在让**变得更便宜。

segments.en: Effective today, Canada will allow immediate expensing for most new capital investment.
segments.zh: 从今天起，加拿大将允许大多数新资本**立即费用化。

segments.en: Two-thirds of all assets will now qualify for machinery and manufacturing equipment to software patents.
segments.zh: 三分之二的资产将有资格，涵盖机械、制造设备到软件专利。

segments.en: R&D, fiber, rail, pipelines, and other infrastructure that is needed to connect our economy.
segments.zh: 研发、光纤、铁路、管道以及其他连接我们经济所需的基础设施。

segments.en: The effect is straightforward. When you invest in Canada, you can deduct substantially more of that investment immediately.
segments.zh: 效果很直接。当你在加拿大**时，可以立即扣除更多**额。

segments.en: We call it the productivity mega-deduction, in part because we use super-deduction in the last budget.
segments.zh: 我们称之为生产力超级扣除，部分原因是上次预算中使用了超级扣除。
